verdict.rationale: NVIDIA B200 is a hardware GPU/system platform (compute infrastructure) for training and running AI workloads, not an end-user application with a data-facing UI that surfaces AI-generated insights from a user's data. Generating and presenting in-product insights/suggestions from data is an application-layer capability that would run on top of this hardware, not something the B200 itself ships — this is a category error for the product type.
